caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of textured, light beige fabric with frayed edges, centered on a larger plain, off-white background. The fabric sample features an embroidered geometric pattern in its center, consisting primarily of red, green, and tan thread. The central design is a diamond shape outlined with tan thread, containing a symmetrical arrangement of smaller red diamond and flower-like motifs interspersed with green linear elements, which resemble stems and leaves. The four corners of the inner diamond are accentuated with clusters of red motifs and intersecting angled green stitches, forming a balanced, repeated composition. The space surrounding the fabric swatch remains blank except for a small, neat printed label beneath it that reads "Emily Declam."
title: Embroidery Detail
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
